name: Submit TOTP Sign-In
summary: Attempts TOTP authentication for an already identified durable account and establishes an authenticated session only when the one-time code is accepted.

requiredInputs.description: Previously identified account email used to resolve the durable identity.
Current time-based one-time code generated by the enrolled authenticator.

sourceReferences.note: VerifyTotpAsync contains the reusable TOTP proof validation but currently accepts a resolved userId rather than anonymous email identity.
Canonical web surface exists, but verify() is currently a TODO and does not invoke a server operation.
